stories.title: Suurhoffbrug richting Maasvlakte deels gesloten vanwege scheuren in de constructie

en.title: Suurhoffbrug towards Maasvlakte partially closed due to cracks in the structure
en.summary: The western Suurhoffbrug on the A15 has been partially closed after inspections found cracks in one of the bridge's main beams. Two lanes toward Maasvlakte are closed and traffic is being diverted onto the emergency lane.

stories.title: Scheuren ontdekt in brug richting Maasvlakte, verkeer moet over vluchtstrook

en.title: Cracks discovered in bridge towards Maasvlakte, traffic must use emergency lane
en.summary: Inspections revealed cracks in a main beam of the western Suurhoffbrug toward Maasvlakte. The road authority has closed two regular lanes and is directing all traffic onto the emergency lane for safety.

stories.title: Ben Saunders, eerste winnaar van The Voice, verpestte zijn carrière door geweldpleging

en.title: Ben Saunders, first winner of The Voice, damaged his career through violent conduct
en.summary: Ben Saunders won the first season of The Voice and appeared poised for a successful music career, but later became known for violent behavior that harmed his professional prospects.

stories.title: Ed Sheeran zonder band en voorprogramma’s: artiesten stappen uit tournee na schrappen Macklemore

en.title: Ed Sheeran without band and opening acts: artists withdraw from tour after Macklemore removal
en.summary: After Macklemore was dropped from Ed Sheeran's tour opener lineup, the remaining supporting artists and Sheeran's backing band have also withdrawn from the tour.

stories.title: Tribunaal veroordeelt Kosovaarse oud-president Hashim Thaçi tot 25 jaar cel voor oorlogsmisdaden

en.title: Tribunal convicts Kosovo's former president Hashim Thaçi to 25 years in prison for war crimes
en.summary: An international tribunal has sentenced former Kosovo president Hashim Thaçi to 25 years imprisonment for war crimes committed during the Kosovo conflict.

stories.title: Kosovaarse oud-president veroordeeld tot 25 jaar cel voor oorlogsmisdaden

en.title: Kosovo's former president convicted to 25 years in prison for war crimes
en.summary: A Kosovo tribunal found Hashim Thaçi was a key figure in the arrest, torture and killing of innocent civilians, resulting in lengthy prison sentences for him and three other former politicians.

stories.title: Tour van Ed Sheeran op losse schroeven; voorprogramma en band haken af na wegsturen pro-Palestijnse rapper Macklemore

en.title: Ed Sheeran's tour in jeopardy; opening act and band withdraw after pro-Palestine rapper Macklemore sent away
en.summary: Ed Sheeran's tour faced disruption after the opening act and band members departed following the removal of pro-Palestine rapper Macklemore from the event.

stories.title: Europese Commissie wil een harde leeftijdsgrens voor kinderen op sociale media: 13 jaar

en.title: European Commission wants hard age limit for children on social media: 13 years
en.summary: The European Commission is proposing new legislation to protect children from social media companies by implementing stricter algorithms and limiting notification systems.

stories.title: Kosovaarse ex-president Thaci krijgt 25 jaar cel voor oorlogsmisdaden, rellen na vonnis

en.title: Kosovo's ex-president Thaçi receives 25 years prison for war crimes, riots follow verdict
en.summary: The Kosovo tribunal in The Hague sentenced former president Hashim Thaçi to 25 years in prison for war crimes including murder and torture during the 1990s Kosovo war, with three former military commanders also convicted.

stories.title: Europese Commissie wil verbod op sociale media voor kinderen onder 13 jaar en beperkt gebruik tot 15 jaar

en.title: European Commission wants ban on social media for children under 13 years and limited use until 15 years
en.summary: The European Commission is proposing restrictions on social media access for children under 13 and limited usage provisions for those under 15 years old.

stories.title: EU wil verbod op sociale media voor kinderen tot dertien jaar

en.title: EU wants to ban social media for children under thirteen years
en.summary: The European Commission proposed legislation to prohibit access to social media platforms including Instagram, TikTok, and Snapchat for children under thirteen years old.

stories.title: Voorprogramma's en band Ed Sheeran verlaten tour na schrappen Macklemore

en.title: Opening acts and Ed Sheeran's band leave tour after Macklemore dropped
en.summary: Ed Sheeran's backing band and remaining opening acts withdrew from his American Loop tour following the removal of rapper Macklemore as an opener due to pro-Palestine statements made on stage.
